company.shortDescription: Zenity provides an AI security and governance platform that monitors, manages, and protects AI agents, applications, and automations
company.description: Zenity provides an AI security and governance platform designed to help organizations discover, monitor, and secure AI agents, low-code applications, and automations. The platform provides visibility into AI agent activity, risk assessment, policy enforcement, and threat protection across enterprise environments. It supports governance of AI systems by managing agent configurations, permissions, behaviors, and runtime activities.

aiResearchSummary.text: Zenity is researching data flow analysis for computing systems deploying multiple software applications. The work titled data flow analysis for computing systems deploying multiple software focuses on constructing data flow graphs with vertices for data locations and edges for data movements across applications. This supports understanding and controlling how information traverses SaaS, cloud, and endpoint environments, highlighting research in multi application data flow modeling and cross system data movement analysis.
